openings.claim: Repair current storage addresses using movement-linked exception-slip updates and reservation-identity checks, retaining surname dividers. Fast cart pickups challenge compulsory shelving as the route to speed.
openings.discriminator: Distinguish stale locations from household-surname mismatches. Compare retrieval and second searches with verified identities/locations, matching arrival volume, book size and desk load; cart speed may disappear after matching.
openings.probe: The existing evening clerk uses existing paper, two shelves and return cart; verifies recipients and keeps names/contact details behind the desk. Record locations, movements, searches and completion times. Cap daily preparation including preparatory corrections at ten clerk-minutes; stop if exceeded and record ongoing upkeep separately.
openings.uncertainty: Identity-check capability, mismatch causation, sustained benefit and update burden are unconfirmed. Source probes account for post-opening work differently; separate recording must not exempt preparatory corrections from the cap. Cart evidence is sensitive to volume and size.

openings.claim: Concentrated arrivals may make waiting dominate delays even after accurate retrieval.
openings.discriminator: Late verified first-location pickups concentrated in the burst support queueing; repeated searches outside the burst support retrieval errors. Little waiting and search-dominated delays defeat queueing dominance.
openings.probe: Under D1 constraints, record arrival, service start, retrieval and handoff on the private existing timing sheet without changing priority; separate waiting from search time.
openings.uncertainty: Counts establish no waiting duration. Timestamping may itself delay service. Reader interviews may not represent evening readers.

decision: Compare bounded mechanisms before choosing intervention. Require 95% of available-hold pickups within two minutes and zero wrong-reader handoffs. All evidence is synthetic; neither mechanism nor target attainment is demonstrated.
